name: FirmAdapt

Named founding team (3 people) with prior-employer logos, but no visible client case studies/logos of paying customers, which slightly caps credibility.

name: Frontier Foundry

service_categories: AI platform products (Limni, Kundi, Foundry Lab)
quality_notes: Polished, content-rich Next.js/Astro site with named founder (ex-FDIC CIO), real case studies, industry-specific pages, glossary, media appearances, and a coherent 'sovereign/deterministic/quantum-resilient AI' brand narrative — notably more substantive than typical AI-consulting shells, though visual design leans corporate/generic-enterprise rather than distinctive.

service_categories: fractional AI leadership / Center of Excellence

name: aiChemist
what_they_do: Atlanta-based fractional AI consultancy that diagnoses operational bottlenecks in SMBs then builds custom business-process automation, AI integrations, and revenue/growth ops systems, priced as a $1,500 roadmap plus $2-5K/mo build-and-maintain retainer.
quality_notes: Clear, specific offer-driven copy with a distinct "diagnose before you build" positioning, ROI calculator, and concrete pricing — stronger content than most template sites, but the page title mislabels itself as "agentic SaaS" and design is a fairly standard single-page agency template without a distinctive visual identity.

name: CoreAi Consulting
what_they_do: A Phoenix, AZ-based AI consulting firm offering generative AI strategy, implementation, governance, model risk management, and custom AI/software integration services for businesses.
quality_notes: Built on GoDaddy Website Builder with generic template styling (stock fonts, no distinctive visual identity); claims broad service menu and Fortune 100 experience but has zero named case studies, testimonials, or team members despite a 'Reviews from Our Clients' section header with no content — reads as an unsubstantiated small/solo shop rather than a credible established firm.

name: Dynapt
what_they_do: Dynapt is an AI agents and automation consultancy building production-ready custom AI agents/automation for specific verticals (surgery centers, law firms, manufacturing, auto dealerships, sales, nonprofits). Based in Georgetown, Texas.
quality_notes: Site is a fully client-side-rendered React SPA that serves almost no content in raw HTML (title/meta only), making it unable to be evaluated via curl/WebFetch — no case studies, testimonials, team info, or client names were retrievable from any of 3 pages attempted. Sitemap shows a reasonable vertical-specific page structure (13 routes) suggesting some content investment, but nothing about design quality or copy depth could be confirmed.

name: Evren AI
what_they_do: Evren AI is an enterprise AI consulting and development firm that designs, builds, and deploys AI-powered products including custom AI agents, generative AI/RAG apps, ML systems, process automation, and chatbots.
service_categories: machine learning & deep learning (predictive, computer vision, NLP)
quality_notes: Polished Next.js site with strong structured content (schema.org markup, FAQ, named services, founder letter, named case study with iSeedoc/HIPAA telehealth), claims 50+ team members and 100+ projects across two offices (Houston & Dubai); copy is confident and specific rather than generic template filler, though visual design leans on common SaaS-agency conventions (rounded pill nav, warm-white/navy palette).

name: GoGloby
what_they_do: GoGloby is an "Applied AI Engineering" partner that helps established software companies deploy Claude/LLM-based AI and AI agents into production, offering both consulting/dev services and vetted AI-engineer staff augmentation.
quality_notes: Content is substantive and specific with named enterprise clients (Zillow, GitLab, Hasbro, Tata), quantified claims, and named testimonials, giving strong credibility; however the site is a fairly generic WordPress/Yoast build with heavy plugin bloat and templated visual design, not a distinctive design benchmark.

name: Hexaa
what_they_do: Hexaa builds custom document automation/intelligent document processing pipelines (classification, extraction, validation, ERP/TMS/AP integration) tailored to a client's operations, code owned by the client.
quality_notes: Distinctive, specific copy (named example invoices, confidence-threshold mechanics, '47+ engagements') avoids generic AI-agency boilerplate; clean modern Next.js build with real product-style UI mockups of the pipeline rather than stock imagery. Scale/team size and named client logos aren't clearly shown, slightly limiting credibility verification.

name: Nimbusnext
what_they_do: Nimbusnext is a Microsoft cloud partner/IT consultancy that also markets "Yavi", a branded no-code AI/data platform for document ingestion, curation, and LLM-based application building, sold alongside industry-specific professional services.
quality_notes: Dated WordPress/LayerSlider template with generic stock-style icon grids and stacked bullet copy; content mixes cloud-modernization messaging with a bolted-on AI product pitch rather than a focused AI-consulting narrative.

name: Pure Math AI
what_they_do: Pure Math AI positions itself as a boutique AI/data-science consulting firm that turns experimental AI projects into production systems for regulated industries like finance and healthcare, marketed as a cheaper alternative to large enterprise consultancies.
service_categories: custom AI/ML solutions for finance (sales/outreach tools)
quality_notes: Built on a generic Wix template with thin, marketing-only copy; no case studies, client names, team bios, or portfolio evidence to substantiate claims, and named products (AdvisorPulse, AcoustiCast) appear unverified/self-referential.

name: Rytsense Technologies
what_they_do: Rytsense Technologies is an offshore-style AI and custom software development company (India/USA/UAE/UK offices) offering agentic AI, generative AI/LLM apps, ML, and broader enterprise software/dev services across 15+ industries.
quality_notes: Templated Next.js site with generic dev-shop AI positioning and buzzword-heavy taglines; claims to have served Virgin, Ford, IKEA, Disney, Fidelity, TCS which reads as implausible/inflated for a firm of this profile, undermining credibility. No distinctive visual identity or deep original content observed.

name: SimplAI
what_they_do: SimplAI is an enterprise software vendor selling a proprietary "Agent OS" platform for building, governing, and scaling AI agents across cloud, on-prem, and air-gapped environments — not a consulting service.
quality_notes: Modern Next.js SaaS marketing site with polished product-positioning copy, but it's a platform/product company (Agent OS) rather than an AI consultancy, so it's out of scope regardless of site polish.

name: Soothsayer Analytics
what_they_do: Soothsayer Analytics is a Michigan/Ohio-based data science and AI consulting firm that designs, develops, and deploys end-to-end machine learning and generative AI solutions for enterprise clients across manufacturing, retail, insurance, energy, and healthcare.
quality_notes: Content is substantive with named solutions (AuGENT, ESG Analytics), real case studies, blog, podcast, and industry pages, signaling a genuine established firm; however the visual design is dated/templated (stock Bootstrap-carousel feel, cluttered mega-menu, generic stock imagery) rather than a distinctive modern brand.

name: WhiteBox
what_they_do: WhiteBox is an AI/ML consulting firm delivering end-to-end AI projects for businesses — from strategy and data engineering to custom algorithm development and production deployment.
service_categories: custom AI/ML algorithm development (generative, predictive, NLP, computer vision)
quality_notes: Clean, well-structured Webflow site with a clear 5-step methodology narrative, named named case studies with real client (Vodafone) and quantified problem framing, and named service categories rather than vague buzzwords — a solid content benchmark, though visual design is competent rather than distinctive.

name: Cake Studio AI
what_they_do: A Colorado-based small AI consulting firm helping SMBs and startups adopt AI pragmatically, offering staff AI training, business process/pain-point analysis, technical advisory, and custom AI solutions including RAG and AI agents.
quality_notes: Generic Squarespace template with minimal branding (empty meta description) and light copy; credibility comes mainly from named team members with PhDs and a stated HIPAA/health IT specialization rather than case studies or portfolio depth.
